name: 多数の移動先を小見出しで分類する四列メニュー
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0113 多数の移動先を小見出しで分類する四列メニュー.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: normalized-original-source-component-crop-647x390. Image 3: secondary-component-preview. Image 4: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Create one standalone Japanese Lighthouse mega-menu at exactly 647x390, matching the normalized source crop. Image 1 is the full source screenshot for context; Image 2 is the exact crop and controls four-column proportions, line density, hierarchy and visual spacing; Image 3 controls every Japanese label and section order; Image 4 controls palette only. Use a flat pure-white canvas with four compact vertical text columns, no card background, dividers, promo panel, browser frame or footer. Preserve every Japanese label exactly as listed and in the same order. Column 1: section 「ロゴとブランド」 with 「ロゴのデザイン」「ブランドの指針」「名刺と文房具」「書体と文字」「ロゴ作成ツール」; section 「アートとイラスト」 with 「イラスト」「人工知能を使う制作」「アバターのデザイン」「子どもの絵本」「肖像画」「漫画」「パターン」「タトゥー」「絵コンテ」「デジタルアート」; section 「その他」 with 「デザインの相談」. Column 2: section 「ウェブとアプリ」 with 「ウェブサイト」「アプリ」「使いやすさ」「紹介ページ」「アイコン」; section 「製品とゲーム」 with 「製品のデザイン」「キャラクター」「ゲームのアート」「配信向けの画像」; section 「印刷物」 with 「チラシ」「パンフレット」「ポスター」「メニュー」. Column 3: section 「視覚のデザイン」 with 「画像の編集」「画像の生成」「発表資料」「背景の削除」「情報を伝える図」「線画」「画像形式の変換」; section 「マーケティング」 with 「交流サービスの画像」「投稿とバナー」「メールのデザイン」「ウェブのバナー」「看板」; section 「パッケージと表紙」 with 「包装とラベル」「書籍のデザイン」「書籍の表紙」「アルバムの表紙」. Column 4: section 「建築と建物」 with 「建築と内装」「庭園」「建物の設計」「照明」; section 「服飾と商品」 with 「服のデザイン」「装飾品」「ジュエリー」; section 「立体のデザイン」 with 「建築の立体図」「工業製品の立体図」「衣服と商品」「立体のキャラクター」「風景の立体図」「ゲームの立体図」「立体のジュエリー」. Maintain four clear columns and the reference’s compact readable line spacing; fit all 71 text elements without wrapping or clipping. Use Meiryo-style Japanese sans serif; section headings bold dark slate, body links regular dark slate with strong contrast. Keep top and side insets close to the preview; avoid oversized type, large gaps, tiny illegible text or empty extra canvas. No source-only RX/NEW badges, no icons, CTA or added content. Pure white #FFFFFF, dark slate #526173 supporting text and near-black main text; no green accent, mint wash, gradients, artwork, shadow or watermark.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; Do not invent an outer card around a flat component. Only existing card surfaces use rounded corners, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows; flat headings, lists and settings stay flat white. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: No active state or CTA appears in the localized preview. Use pure white with high-contrast slate text. Do not add the source screenshot's English NEW badge, logo-maker icon, or other source-only decoration.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION:
The owner says the 354x44 LH07-0025 version was too large/spacious, while the 180x28 version was too compact. Use a comfortable middle with readable Japanese typography and balanced label padding. LH07-0025 v006 at 300x40 is the calibration for that segmented control only; never force this size or the prior 180x28 target onto unrelated components. Follow each component original source for anatomy and component-specific proportions.
reviewNotes: Visually reviewed at normalized 647x390 against original crop and Japanese preview; 71 exact labels across four columns, no clipping, and source-only decoration omitted. Candidate image only; native editability and app behavior are unverified.
